title: Regular constant scalars act monomorphically on flat module sheaves
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site, $A$ a commutative ring, and $A_{\mathcal C}$ the constant ring sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Let $M$ be a sheaf of $A_{\mathcal C}$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] that is flat [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. Fix $a\in A$ such that the function $A\to A$, $x\mapsto ax$, is injective. Then multiplication by the constant scalar $a$ is a monomorphism on both $A_{\mathcal C}$ and $M$. Explicitly, for every object $U$ of $\mathcal C$ the maps $A_{\mathcal C}(U)\to A_{\mathcal C}(U)$ and $M(U)\to M(U)$ given by $s\mapsto as$ are injective. Neither a domain hypothesis on $A$ nor an enough-points hypothesis on $\mathcal C$ is required.

source.place: Tag 03EI (lemma-sheafification-exact), applied to the constant ring presheaf A, followed by Tag 03ER (definition-flat), sheaf clause (3). The constant-module tensor-unit identification is in section-tensor-product.
